method: Exploratory matched-opening comparison: current100ms, public-history tie-break100ms, current500ms; 40 identical six-ply openings with both seats per arm. Twelve BelowNormal workers, arms sequential. Primary metric is completion difference versus control; see report for paired intervals and all-scheduled win-share sensitivity bounds. Card win shares condition on complete seat groups and can be biased. No browser policy promotion.
